sources.entry: Graphis - Open-source app that generates images from text with the MOSS-Image model, locally on Apple silicon. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Campfire7/graphis) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Graphis is an open-source macOS app that generates images from text prompts entirely on-device on Apple silicon, using the MOSS-Image model through mflux and MLX.
keywords: run ai art on my mac
summary.what_it_does: Graphis takes a text prompt and an optional negative prompt and produces an image on the Mac, with no prompts or images sent to the cloud. It offers five output formats up to 1280 pixels and three quality presets (Fast with a turbo module, through Best), plus manual control of steps and guidance. A reference image can be used as a template, with a slider for how closely to follow it. Style, light and detail LoRA modules can be taken from a small checked catalog or supplied as your own files. Generation runs in a queue that resumes after a restart and shows a time estimate that improves with each image. Settings from a finished image can be reused to change one thing at a time.
use_cases: generate images from text on a Mac without cloud services
create artwork offline on Apple silicon
produce images with a reference picture as a template
apply style or detail LoRA modules to generated images
how_to_run: Download Graphis-.zip from Releases and unzip it
Open it via System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Graphis.app)
Under New Image, click Download in the Set Up MOSS-Image card (about 15.2 GB model and turbo module)
Build from source: zsh bauen.sh (requires Xcode Command Line Tools and uv)
notable: Fully local inference: prompts and images never leave the computer, with no account, cloud or analytics
Model and modules downloaded only on explicit click, pinned to fixed revisions and checked by SHA-256
Reproducible build with pinned Python and packages, ad hoc signing per Mach-O file, and fixed timestamps
English and German interface following the system language
Update check is optional, queries GitHub at most once a day, and never downloads anything automatically
caveats: Requires Apple silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 26.2 or later
About 17 GB free disk space; 24 GB+ memory recommended, 16 GB untested
Not notarized by Apple; first launch needs a manual approval step or quarantine removal
No built-in content filter; the README states prompts and images are not checked or blocked
summary.license: MIT (Graphis code); bundled components under their own licenses; model and modules under Apache 2.0 per their model cards
